name: Calibration 170
description: Controller tuning profile, not for soldering. Ramp is 1.0 C/s, which this iron can actually follow: it now manages ~1.47 C/s gross and losses take ~0.13 C/s by 130 C, so the earlier 1.39 C/s ramp was unachievable above ~102 C and guaranteed a growing lag. Stays below the ~180 C stall so the whole run yields valid data.
